source_title: A Role for Thalamic Projection GABAergic Neurons in Circadian Responses to Light
node_relevance_reason: Directly characterises Sox14+ GABAergic thalamic projection neurons of the IGL/LGv, including origin, location and function.
summary: Thalamic GABAergic projection neurons defined by Sox14 are found in the IGL and also contribute to prethalamic LGv; they arise in p2 and migrate tangentially. Optogenetic stimulation of Sox14+ IGL/LGv neurons resets circadian activity rhythms; Sox14+ axons densely innervate superficial SC and sparsely the SCN ventral edge. Sox14+ neurons are a thalamic class prominent in the IGL that also contribute to the prethalamic LGv; their inputs are skewed to visual networks, with limited arousal-system input.
quotes: Thalamic GABAergic projection neurons are specified during embryonic development within the rostral portion of the second diencephalic prosomere
Hence, the mature IGL and LGv are characterized by a heterogenous cellular composition that includes Sox14 1 GABAergic thalamic neurons.

Notably, dense innervation was seen in the superficial gray and optic layers of the superior colliculus (SCs; Fig. 1M), while few immunoreactive fibers were present at the ventral edge of the SCN (Fig. 1N)
While the Sox14 1 neurons constitute a thalamic cell class prominently found in the IGL, they also contribute to the prethalamic LGv nucleus.
Our monosynaptic restricted retrograde tracing places the Sox14 1 IGL/LGv firmly within the visual system, with input from cortical and subcortical visual structures.

summary: IGL GABAergic GH projections to the SCN arise from NPY+ or Enk+ neurons; other IGL/vLGNe neurons project contralaterally to IGL/vLGNe and dLGN.
quotes: GH projections are GABAergic, are important for modulating circadian function (Harrington, 1997), and originate from NPY + or Enk + neurons in the IGL
